answer: Open a prediction market on each identity: anyone stakes on whether it stays productive and honest over the next epochs, and the live price becomes a public suspicion score gating reward eligibility. A farm of a hundred puppets cannot defend that many thin books at once — honest shorts keep the books honest, so each ripple of doubt chokes a clone's payouts, while a velvet-smooth, well-priced market marks a true grove of healthy agents. Suspicion stops being free talk and becomes funded conviction.
